title: LDBC command-mode gap capture
description: Add first-class LDBC PostgreSQL interactive command-mode support and capture the first real FusionDB compatibility gap beyond artifact/help readiness.
result: LDBC native smoke now reaches run_mode=command with the official PostgreSQL implementation jar. The captured blocker is FusionDB PgWire/JDBC transaction isolation metadata: SHOW TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL does not return a result set for PostgreSQL JDBC/Hikari.
